name: Mukat Pipes Limited
about: Mukat Pipes Limited manufactures and sells large diameter submerged arc welded pipes in India. The company offers MS shells for infrastructure, longitudinal and spiral saw pipes, site pipe fabrication, and penstock pipes. Its products are used in refineries fertilizer plants, thermal power plants, industrial use for oil, gas, circulating water system, water pipelines, and as penstocks on hydro-electric power generation projects. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India.
